critical_code_review_comments: LosWashMetricsPanel.js used showTgt/setShowTgt/tgtT/setTgtT/tgtG/setTgtG without any useState declaration — build didn't catch it because setters were assigned inside a callback. ErrorBoundary caught it at runtime. Standard oversight; agents should always match every setter/getter to a useState call.

rca of the issue: LosWashMetricsPanel bug RCA: E1 added <button onClick={() => { setShowTgt(...); setTgtT(...); setTgtG(...); }} …> plus the target form JSX referencing showTgt/tgtT/tgtG, but forgot to add the corresponding `const [showTgt, setShowTgt] = useState(false); const [tgtT, setTgtT] = useState(''); const [tgtG, setTgtG] = useState('');` declarations. Because setters were referenced only inside an onClick closure, the ReferenceError surfaces only on first click, not at initial render — hence any manual render-only check would miss it. Repro: open LOS & Wash panel → click ⚙ Hedefleri Ayarla → ErrorBoundary triggers. Fix applied by testing agent.
